_about: Pell's shell-tile sequences (pell.md §3, art decision on the story's beaded cord wraps), authored as data: original, no script, no number. `call` is the left wrap, turn by turn from the wrist up (each turn a run of five to seven tiles in four tones: bone, reed, dark, nacre); the right wrap is the response, the same tones mirrored (pell_costume.tile_sequence reverses the turns and each run). `ankle` is the right ankle cord's three tiles. UI may author a Swell panel from these lists, never from a render of the costume.
